title: [Pre Order] Apple Mac Mini M6 12‑Core CPU 12‑Core GPU 16GB RAM 256GB SSD from $1289 Delivered @ Apple Education Store
body:
Deal: [Pre Order] Apple Mac Mini M6 12‑Core CPU 12‑Core GPU 16GB RAM 256GB SSD from $1289 Delivered @ Apple Education Store

[3dprintdeals] shame about the massive price hikes due to rampocalypse.
[gadgetguy] They make a big deal about AI performance increases but does anyone care?
[panda1010101] The previous gen M4 Mac Mini was very popular for locally hosted AI. I think this version will be even more popular
[3dprintdeals] That was mainly due to being a cheap mac with computer use and openclaw with computer use. Not so much for local LLM
[panda1010101] Oh yeah, I guess you can pay for API keys and run a local agent instead. But the purist in me wants local LLMs!
[3dprintdeals] @panda1010101: Maybe with 64gb memory, running Qwen 3.8 Q6 or so
[3dprintdeals] Yes for the Mac Studios now with M5 Ultra. Up to 512gb memory in October for local inference will be cheaper and faster than 2x DGX sparks.
Yep, it will cost you four kidneys
[congo] The 256GB version is almost $16K , 2x DGX sparks 128GB are around the same price ?
[M00Cow] they do if you want to run a localLLM. More bang for your buck them a Nvidia chipset
[dosada] Thanks. But we know how to read the title
[panda1010101] The fact that OP says “great deal” makes me want to laugh and cry.
[geshc] 20% increase in multi core. They are hiding the single core performance though
[TestIgnoreMe] Wow, what a price increase!
I bought my Mac mini with the M4 Pro chip, 48GB memory and 512GB SSD back in July last year for $2,235 via AOC and Coles gift card
no ragrets.
